declarations.type:
∀ {RetryKey : Type u} {Certificate : Type v} [inst : DecidableEq RetryKey] (validate : Certificate → Prop)
  [inst_1 : DecidablePred validate]
  (ledger : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryPublicationLedger.PublicationLedger RetryKey Certificate)
  (retryKey : RetryKey) (candidate winner : Certificate),
  ledger retryKey = some winner →
    ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryPublicationLedger.atomicPublish validate ledger retryKey candidate =
      (ledger, ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryPublicationLedger.PublishOutcome.existing winner)
declarations.name: ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryPublicationLedger.existing_winner_is_returned_without_republication

declarations.type:
∀ {RetryKey : Type u} {Certificate : Type v} [inst : DecidableEq RetryKey] (validate : Certificate → Prop)
  [inst_1 : DecidablePred validate]
  (ledger : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryPublicationLedger.PublicationLedger RetryKey Certificate)
  (retryKey : RetryKey) (candidate : Certificate),
  ledger retryKey = none →
    ¬validate candidate →
      ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryPublicationLedger.atomicPublish validate ledger retryKey candidate =
        (ledger, ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryPublicationLedger.PublishOutcome.rejected)
declarations.name: ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryPublicationLedger.invalid_candidate_cannot_win_empty_key

declarations.type:
∀ {RetryKey : Type u} {Certificate : Type v} [inst : DecidableEq RetryKey] (validate : Certificate → Prop)
  [inst_1 : DecidablePred validate]
  (ledger : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryPublicationLedger.PublicationLedger RetryKey Certificate)
  (retryKey : RetryKey) (candidate : Certificate),
  ledger retryKey = none →
    validate candidate →
      (ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryPublicationLedger.atomicPublish validate ledger retryKey candidate).fst
            retryKey =
          some candidate ∧
        (ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryPublicationLedger.atomicPublish validate ledger retryKey candidate).snd =
          ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryPublicationLedger.PublishOutcome.won candidate
declarations.name: ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryPublicationLedger.valid_candidate_wins_empty_key

declarations.type:
∀ {RetryKey : Type u} {Certificate : Type v} [inst : DecidableEq RetryKey] (validate : Certificate → Prop)
  [inst_1 : DecidablePred validate]
  (ledger : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryPublicationLedger.PublicationLedger RetryKey Certificate)
  (retryKey : RetryKey) (firstCandidate laterCandidate : Certificate),
  ledger retryKey = none →
    validate firstCandidate →
      have first :=
        ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryPublicationLedger.atomicPublish validate ledger retryKey firstCandidate;
      have later :=
        ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryPublicationLedger.atomicPublish validate first.fst retryKey laterCandidate;
      first.snd = ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryPublicationLedger.PublishOutcome.won firstCandidate ∧
        later.fst retryKey = some firstCandidate ∧
          later.snd = ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryPublicationLedger.PublishOutcome.existing firstCandidate
declarations.name: ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryPublicationLedger.installed_winner_is_sticky_for_any_later_candidate

declarations.type:
∀ {RetryKey : Type u} {Certificate : Type v} [inst : DecidableEq RetryKey] (validate : Certificate → Prop)
  [inst_1 : DecidablePred validate]
  (ledger : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryPublicationLedger.PublicationLedger RetryKey Certificate)
  (retryKey : RetryKey) (invalidCandidate winner : Certificate),
  ledger retryKey = some winner →
    ¬validate invalidCandidate →
      ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryPublicationLedger.atomicPublish validate ledger retryKey invalidCandidate =
        (ledger, ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryPublicationLedger.PublishOutcome.existing winner)
declarations.name: ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryPublicationLedger.invalid_losing_retry_still_recovers_existing_winner
